user.title: Fledge
user.description: Choose the Nest thermostat running Fledge. It has to be connected to Home Assistant over MQTT first. New to Fledge? Read [the documentation]({docs}).

confirm.title: Fledge
confirm.description: A Nest thermostat running Fledge was found (serial {serial}). Put Home Assistant on its screen?

cards.title: What the thermostat shows
cards.description: Each device is a card on the thermostat, in this order (drag to reorder). Turn the ring to browse them, press to open one: a light dims, a switch switches, a thermostat sets its temperature, a speaker its volume. After setup, arrange them in the Fledge panel in the sidebar. [How the cards work]({docs}cards.html).

data.dim_off: Turning a light down past 1% turns it off

data_description.entities: Lights (a light group works for a whole room), switches, fans, other thermostats, speakers, blinds, cameras, alarms, scenes and scripts. Names, limits, the glance and its faces are set afterwards in the Fledge panel in the sidebar.
data_description.wake: What shows when you walk up to it, turn the ring or press it while its screen is dark.
data_description.wake_device: Wake straight into one of the devices above instead.
data_description.weather: A weather entity: the Nest's own weather (outside temperature, humidity and forecast) and the glance.
data_description.far: When the Nest sees someone across the room. Fledge keeps the Nest's Farsight on, so its motion sensor always reports at once; Stay dark keeps the screen fully dark.
data_description.near: When someone comes close, without touching it.
data_description.card_idle: How long the screen stays on whatever you opened (the cards, or a device on them) with nothing touched and nobody close. Then it times out to the glance (if someone is still about) or dark, and the next wake starts again from the top.
data_description.dim_off: Turn a light's ring all the way left to switch it off: it holds at 1% for a moment, so a quick spin only dims it. A light that only switches turns off to the left and on to the right.
data_description.outdoor_temperature: Optional: the outside temperature from this sensor rather than the weather entity.
data_description.room_sensor: Optional: the Nest regulates from this sensor instead of its own. The Nest needs Fledge's external temperature option for it, which turns off its Bluetooth (real Nest Temperature Sensors stop working). If its reading stops, the Nest goes back to its own sensor.
data_description.show_thermostat: Off, the Nest still controls your heating, but its screen shows only the devices above: set the temperature from Home Assistant. To stop it being a thermostat at all, turn off its Act as a thermostat switch.

abort.already_configured: This thermostat is already set up.
abort.no_thermostats: No Nest running Fledge was found. Connect it to Home Assistant over MQTT first.
abort.not_fledge: This isn't a thermostat running Fledge.

options.chooser: The device chooser: the thermostat among your devices, zoomed out
options.auto: Automatic: the speaker that's playing, else after sunset a light that's on, else the device chooser
options.thermostat: The thermostat, as the Nest always did

options.wake: What it wakes to, without a touch
options.none: Nothing more than across the room

thermostat_outdated.title: Update the thermostat's Fledge
thermostat_outdated.description: The Nest thermostat {serial} runs a Fledge build older than this integration needs, so some of its cards may not work. Install its update from the thermostat's update entity (Settings → Updates).

room_sensor_unsupported.title: The Nest can't use the room thermometer yet
room_sensor_unsupported.description: The Nest thermostat {serial} is set to regulate from {sensor}, but it runs without Fledge's external temperature option, so it ignores the readings. Update the Nest's Fledge to turn the option on from Home Assistant, or clear Room thermometer in the integration's options.

room_sensor_switch.title: Turn on the Nest's external temperature option

confirm.title: Turn on external temperature
confirm.description: The Nest thermostat {serial} will regulate from your room thermometer. Turning the option on reboots the Nest (its heating pauses for about a minute) and turns off its Bluetooth, so real Nest Temperature Sensors stop working. If the readings stop, the Nest goes back to its own sensor. You can turn it off again with the Nest's External temperature switch.

abort.no_switch: The Nest no longer offers the switch: update its Fledge.

notify.name: Notify on the thermostat
notify.description: Shows a notification on the Nest's screen, waking it, with a chime. A press answers it and a long press (or its time running out) dismisses it; either fires a fledge_notification event with its tag. Returns the tag.

title.name: Title
title.description: A heading above the message, or over the camera's picture.

icon.name: Icon
icon.description: Shown above the title when there's no picture.

camera.name: Camera
camera.description: Shows this camera's picture, taken now, filling the screen: a doorbell's, say.

timeout.name: Timeout
timeout.description: How long it shows before it dismisses itself.

tag.name: Tag
tag.description: Names it, for fledge.dismiss and in its event. Made up if left out.

thermostat.name: Thermostat
thermostat.description: Which Nests show it; all of them if none is chosen.

dismiss.name: Dismiss on the thermostat
dismiss.description: Takes a notification off the Nest's screen.

tag.name: Tag
tag.description: The tag it was shown with.

thermostat.name: Thermostat
thermostat.description: Which Nests to dismiss it from; all of them if none is chosen.

set_schedule.name: Set the Nest's schedule
set_schedule.description: Replaces the named days of a Nest's own weekly schedule, heating or hot water or both, in one write; the other days are kept. An empty list leaves a day with no changes. Writing the heating schedule turns Auto-Schedule off, and sets the temperature that applies now unless the Nest is in Eco.

entity_id.name: Thermostat
entity_id.description: The Nest's thermostat, or any other of its own entities.

heating.name: Heating
heating.description: Days to replace (mon to sun), each a list of changes with a time (HH:MM) and a temp in °C. See the README for an example.

hot_water.name: Hot water
hot_water.description: Days to replace (mon to sun), each a list of on periods with an on and an off time (HH:MM). See the README for an example.

not_a_nest.message: {entity_id} doesn't belong to a Nest thermostat running Fledge.

no_hot_water.message: The Nest {serial} has no hot water schedule.
